title: 第019章 缺灵石的苦恼第020章 残缺的一阶上品符纸
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 第019章缺灵石的苦恼！
李青元盘膝打坐，房屋地脉下，是一条残缺的一阶灵脉，地底灵气涌出。
小院周围，天地灵气也都汇聚而来。
他的双手中，各捏一块灵石。
大椿功运转，吸纳天地灵气、化为己用，体内灵力运转大周天，全身沐浴灵光，吐纳灵气。
咔嚓一声，李青元手中两块灵石失去灵力，被彻底吸收，化作碎石。
李青元长吐一口浊气，体内灵气运转最后一个大周天，而后气归丹田，归于气海中。
李青元面露欣喜道：“没想到，画符也有助于修行。”
半年时间，李青元重点修炼灵力，分出小部分时间学习六种一阶下品符纸，画符过程中，他不断消耗体内灵力和精神力。
消耗之后，不断打坐恢复法力。
一次又一次的消耗、恢复……再消耗、再恢复……不断循环反复下，短短半年时间，修为提升的速度，堪比以往七八个月。
这么看来，画符也是一种凝炼灵力、锤炼精神力的修炼方式。
而这，只是第一个收获。
第二个收获，这半年来，李青元一共学会六种一阶下品符纸。
它们分别是——清洁符、照明符、止血符，轻身符、铁甲符、冰刺符。
前面三种，用于生活、用于辅助。
后面三种，用于斗法、提升实力。
现如今，李青元画出的六种符纸，质量都是正品，甚至还会出现精品。
一阶下品符纸，也分为质量下品、质量正品、质量精品。
举个例子，一阶下品的冰刺符。
质量下品，属于勉强成符，其威力对应炼气一层。
质量正品的，威力对应炼气二层。
质量精品的，威力对应炼气三层。
第三种收获，李青元运用玄牝空间的指导功能，纯熟掌握了画符技艺，并且成功率高达9成。
此外，李青元为了锤炼画符技艺，并未选择先画符、再复制。
他的选择是，复制双倍的符纸材料、符墨，然后再刻画符纸，画符次数多了，更能提升符道技艺。
这样一来，不仅可以凝炼灵气、锤炼神魂，还能提升画符技艺。
此外，他对族长爷爷表现的是——经过半年学习，刻画六种一阶下品符纸的成功率达到了6成。
李青元面露愁苦：“唉，这些符纸要如何换成灵石，供我修行呢？”
半年来，李青元已经暗暗积攒了大几百张符纸
这其中，以轻身符、铁甲符、冰刺符、止血符居多，生活类的清洁符、照明符数量最少。
轻身符、铁甲符、冰刺符、止血符，正品质量的，价值3块灵石。
精品质量的，价值4块灵石。
不过，清洁符、照明符，可就便宜了，使用的符纸材料也是最便宜的，材料价格大概半块灵石一张。
所以，清洁符、照明符，售价也才一块灵石。
李青元按照族长爷爷提供的符纸价格，初步估算后得到一个结论。
现如今的他，手上符纸全部出手后，价值不低于上千灵石。
毕竟，李青元开挂了。
画符材料，资源翻倍。
成功率更是高的离谱，足足九成，而且精品符纸也不少。
最重要一点，他画出来的符纸，不需要提供给家族修士，也无法提供给他们，只能自己攒起来。
并且，他的符纸，扣除人力外，基本不需要成本。
不像族长爷爷，一年下来，画出价值两千灵石的符纸，成本需要几百灵石。
第019章缺灵石的苦恼！

Chapter 019 The trouble of lacking spiritual stones!
Li Qingyuan sat cross-legged and meditated. Under the earth vein of the house was an incomplete first-order spiritual vein, and the underground spiritual energy surged out.
Around the small courtyard, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth also gathered.
In each of his hands, he held a spiritual stone.
The Great Chun Gong operates, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and turning it into one's own use. The spiritual power in the body circulates around the sky, bathing the whole body in spiritual light, and exhaling spiritual energy.
With a click, the two spiritual stones in Li Qingyuan's hand lost their spiritual power, were completely absorbed, and turned into rubble.
"Hoo~"
Li Qingyuan exhaled a long breath of turbid air, and the spiritual energy in his body circulated for the last time, and then the energy returned to his Dantian and the sea of energy.
Li Qingyuan said with joy on his face: "I didn't expect that drawing talismans can also help practice."
For half a year, Li Qingyuan focused on cultivating his spiritual power, and spent a small part of his time learning six kinds of first-level low-grade talisman paper. During the process of drawing the talismans, he continued to consume his spiritual and mental power.
After consumption, keep meditating to restore mana.
Over and over again, consumption, recovery... consumption, recovery again... the cycle repeats over and over again. In just half a year, the speed of cultivation improvement is comparable to that of the past seven or eight months.
From this point of view, drawing talismans is also a way of practice to condense spiritual power and temper mental power.
And this is just the first harvest.
The second gain is that in the past six months, Li Qingyuan has learned a total of six first-level low-grade talismans.
They are - Cleaning Talisman, Lighting Talisman, Hemostatic Talisman, Light Body Talisman, Iron Armor Talisman, and Ice Thorn Talisman.
The first three are used for daily life and assistance.
The latter three are used for fighting skills and improving strength.
Nowadays, the six types of talisman paper drawn by Li Qingyuan are all genuine in quality, and there are even high-quality products.
The first-level low-quality talisman paper is also divided into low-quality, genuine and high-quality.
For example, the first-level low-grade Ice Thorn Talisman.
It is of low quality, barely a talisman, and its power corresponds to the first level of Qi refining.
It is of genuine quality and its power corresponds to the second level of Qi Refining.
It is of high quality and its power corresponds to the third level of Qi refining.
The third gain was that Li Qingyuan used the guidance function of Xuan Ni Space to master the technique of drawing talismans, and the success rate was as high as 90%.
In addition, in order to hone his skills in drawing talisman, Li Qingyuan did not choose to draw the talisman first and then copy it.
His choice was to copy double the talisman paper materials and talisman ink, and then carve the talisman paper. The more times he drew the talisman, the more he could improve his talisman skills.
In this way, you can not only condense your spiritual energy and temper your soul, but also improve your skills in drawing talisman.
In addition, what he showed to his grandfather, the patriarch, was that after half a year of study, the success rate of carving six first-level low-grade talisman papers reached 60%.
Li Qingyuan looked sad: "Hey, how can I exchange these talismans into spiritual stones for my practice?"
In the past six months, Li Qingyuan has secretly accumulated hundreds of talisman papers.
Among them, the majority are light body charms, iron armor charms, ice spike charms, and hemostatic charms, while the daily cleaning charms and lighting charms are the least numerous.
Light Body Talisman, Iron Armor Talisman, Ice Thorn Talisman, Hemostatic Talisman, genuine quality, worth 3 spiritual stones.
Excellent quality, worth 4 spiritual stones.
However, cleaning talismans and lighting talismans are cheap, and the talisman paper materials used are also the cheapest. The materials cost about half a spiritual stone.
Therefore, the cleaning talisman and lighting talisman only cost one spiritual stone.
Li Qingyuan came to a conclusion after making a preliminary estimate based on the price of the talisman provided by the patriarch's grandfather.
Now, after all the talismans in his hand are sold, their value is no less than thousands of spiritual stones.
After all, Li Qingyuan cheated.
Drawing materials, resources doubled.
The success rate is even more ridiculously high, a full 90%, and there are also many high-quality talismans.
The most important point is that the talismans he drew do not need to be provided to the family monks, and he cannot provide them to them. He can only save them himself.
Moreover, his talisman paper basically costs nothing except manpower.
Unlike the patriarch, the cost of drawing a talisman worth two thousand spiritual stones in one year would be several hundred spiritual stones.
